issues.title: Stop creating labels that already exist
issues.description:
Running `labels create` twice produces duplicates in the project.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Run `python main.py labels create`.
2. Change nothing in `data/labels.json`.
3. Run the same command again.
notes: Labels are identified by name inside their project.
The same name under a different project is a different label.

issues.title: Preview every write before it reaches GitLab
issues.description: There is no way to see what a run would do without writing it. A dry run mode must report each action and change nothing.
notes: The summary has to report what it *would* create, not what it created.
Dry run still needs to read labels, milestones and epics to resolve names to IDs.
acceptance_criteria: No POST, PUT or DELETE request is sent while dry run is on.
The final summary uses the past conditional.
Every created item keeps its scoped title so a real run can skip it later.

issues.title: Replace milestone titles with numeric IDs
issues.description: Issues that declare `"milestone": "Week 2"` fail, because GitLab only accepts a numeric `milestone_id`. Resolve every title to its ID before creating the issue, and never send the raw title.
